description: Chaos Commerce checkout pipeline: computes absurd surcharges, runs parallel warehouse/payment/carrier checks, applies backfiring promo logic, and guarantees order completion.
name: chaos_checkout_workflow

inputParameters.queryExpression: (.cartItems // []) as $list | { itemCount: ([$list[] | (.quantity // 1)] | add // 1), distinctSkus: ($list | length), rawSubtotal: ([$list[] | ((.price // 0) * (.quantity // 1))] | add // 0), lineItems: [$list[] | { id: (.id // "mystery"), name: (.name // "Unidentified Regret"), quantity: (.quantity // 1), unitPrice: (.price // 0), lineTotal: ((.price // 0) * (.quantity // 1)) }] }

inputParameters.expression: (function(){ var qty = Number($.itemCount) || 1; var moods = ['Hissing mildly', 'Bribed with stale Doritos', 'Asleep on forklift', 'Guard-raccoon union break']; var idx = qty % moods.length; return { stockCleared: true, physicalStockFound: -3, imaginaryStockSynthesized: qty + 3, warehouseBin: 'AISLE-404-DAMP-CORNER', raccoonSupervisorStatus: moods[idx] }; })();

(function(){ var digits = ($.last4 || '0000').toString().slice(-4); var amt = Math.round((Number($.subtotal) || 0) * 100) / 100; return { authorized: true, cardLast4: digits, authCode: 'NO-BACKSIES-' + digits, vibeVerdict: amt > 5000 ? 'Financially reckless — our favorite kind of shopper!' : 'Suspiciously frugal, adding extra scrutiny fees.' }; })();

(function(){ var m = ($.method || 'GLACIAL').toString().toUpperCase(); var map = { GLACIAL: { fee: 29.99, label: 'Glacial Continental Drift', eta: '4 to 9 business decades' }, PIGEON: { fee: 64.50, label: 'Uncertified Carrier Pigeon (Blindfolded)', eta: 'Whenever it smells breadcrumbs near your roof' }, DRONE_DROP: { fee: 149.99, label: 'Orbital Drop-Kick (400ft, No Parachute)', eta: 'Look up in 17 minutes and duck' }, TIME_TRAVEL: { fee: 999.99, label: 'Retroactive Bush Toss', eta: 'Arrived last Tuesday behind your neighbor trash can' } }; var chosen = map[m] || map.GLACIAL; return { methodCode: m, carrierLabel: chosen.label, shippingFee: chosen.fee, estimatedDelivery: chosen.eta, boxCondition: 'Pre-crushed hydraulically at the depot so couriers cannot ruin it further' }; })();

inputParameters.promoLabel: SAVE10 Coupon Audacity Penalty (+10% for trying to pay us less)
SAVE50 Extreme Greed Surcharge (+50% — we saved 50% extra for ourselves!)
FREESHIP Medieval Trebuchet Rental Fee (+$99.99 — shipping is free, aiming costs extra)
PLEASE Corporate Pity Discount (-$0.02 — don't spend it all in one fiscal quarter)
Unrecognized/Blank Promo Box Database Null-Byte Surcharge (+$4.99)

inputParameters.expression: (function(){ var r = function(n){ return Math.round(n * 100) / 100; }; var sub = r(Number($.rawSubtotal) || 0); var qty = Number($.itemCount) || 1; var ship = r(Number($.shippingFee) || 29.99); var inconvenienceFee = 19.99; var yachtFee = r(sub * 0.075 + 7.77); var pixelTax = r(qty * 3.33); var promoAdj = r(sub * (Number($.promoRate) || 0) + (Number($.promoFlat) || 0)); var total = Math.max(0.01, r(sub + ship + inconvenienceFee + yachtFee + pixelTax + promoAdj)); return { subtotal: sub, shippingFee: ship, inconvenienceFee: inconvenienceFee, ceoYachtPolishFee: yachtFee, pixelDeliveryTax: pixelTax, promoCode: $.promoCodeNormalized, promoLabel: $.promoLabel, promoAdjustment: promoAdj, grandTotal: total }; })();

inputParameters.queryExpression: { orderId: .orderId, status: "COMPLETED_NO_TAKEBACKS", customer: { name: .customerName, email: .customerEmail, address: .shippingAddress }, lineItems: .cart.lineItems, itemCount: .cart.itemCount, invoice: .invoice, warehouse: .warehouse, payment: .payment, shipping: .shipping }

description: Chaos Commerce Bureaucratic Return Tribunal: subjects return requests to four parallel pointless inspections, a bounded rubber-stamp escalation loop, scoring, and a guaranteed final decision.
name: chaos_return_workflow

inputParameters.expression: (function(){ var phase = ($.lunarPhase || 'CLOUDY').toString().toUpperCase(); var scores = { WANING_REGRET: 28, BLOOD_MOON: 24, WAXING_GIBBOUS: 16, MERCURY_GATORADE: 8, CLOUDY: 12 }; var pts = scores[phase] !== undefined ? scores[phase] : 14; return { checkName: 'Astrological & Mercury Gatorade Alignment Audit', passed: pts >= 15, score: pts, maxScore: 30, finding: pts >= 15 ? 'Lunar phase (' + phase + ') narrowly appeased our warehouse astrologer.' : 'Lunar phase (' + phase + ') clashes violently with Fiscal Q5 Saturn rising.' }; })();

(function(){ var c = Number($.crispness); if (isNaN(c)) c = 50; var looked = String($.eyeContact).toLowerCase() === 'true' || String($.eyeContact).toLowerCase() === 'yes'; var pts = (c >= 83 && c <= 96) ? 26 : (c > 96 ? 9 : 11); if (looked) pts = Math.max(0, pts - 8); var note = (c > 96 ? 'Box corners (' + c + '%) are suspiciously crisp — illegal protractor suspected. ' : (c >= 83 ? 'Box corners (' + c + '%) fall within narrow museum-grade tolerance. ' : 'Box corners (' + c + '%) too soggy for executive cardboard sniffing. ')) + (looked ? 'DEDUCTION: You made direct eye contact with the package, voiding its shyness warranty.' : 'BONUS: You respectfully averted your gaze from the package.'); return { checkName: 'Cardboard Molecular Crispness & Shyness Inspection', passed: pts >= 15, score: pts, maxScore: 30, finding: note }; })();

(function(){ var txt = ($.apology || '').toString().toLowerCase(); var tearCount = Number($.tears) || 0; var hasSorry = txt.indexOf('sorry') >= 0 || txt.indexOf('forgive') >= 0 || txt.indexOf('unworthy') >= 0; var pts = (txt.length >= 25 ? 12 : 4) + (hasSorry ? 10 : 0) + (tearCount >= 3 ? 8 : 2); return { checkName: 'Warehouse Feelings & Tear Salinity Vibecheck', passed: pts >= 16, score: pts, maxScore: 30, finding: hasSorry ? 'Apology detected (' + txt.length + ' chars, ' + tearCount + ' tears). The forklift forgives you slightly.' : 'Insufficient groveling detected (' + tearCount + ' tears). You did not call yourself unworthy even once.' }; })();

(function(){ var s = ($.serialRev || '').toString().trim(); var hasZ = s.toUpperCase().indexOf('X') >= 0 || s.toUpperCase().indexOf('9') >= 0 || s.length >= 6; var pts = s.length === 0 ? 3 : (hasZ ? 18 : 10); return { checkName: 'Backwards Serial Number Numerology Verification', passed: pts >= 12, score: pts, maxScore: 20, finding: s.length === 0 ? 'No backwards serial provided; clerk had to squint into a mirror.' : 'Reverse serial "' + s + '" vibrates at 432Hz bureaucratic compliance.' }; })();
(function(){ return { formCode: 'FORM-27B-STROKE-6', inkFlavor: 'Lukewarm Espresso & Regret', stampedFor: $.returnId, status: 'STAMPED_AND_MISFILED_SUCCESSFULLY' }; })();

(function(){ var total = (Number($.s1) || 0) + (Number($.s2) || 0) + (Number($.s3) || 0) + (Number($.s4) || 0); var tier = total >= 68 ? 'MIRACLE_APPROVAL' : (total >= 45 ? 'CONDITIONAL_APPROVAL' : 'DENIED_WITH_PREJUDICE'); return { totalScore: total, maxPossibleScore: 110, outcomeTier: tier }; })();

inputParameters.tribunalHeadline: APPROVED! (Subject to our standard 98.75% Emotional Restocking & Re-Haunting Fee)
CONDITIONALLY APPROVED! Refunded in non-transferable Chaos Scrip (redeemable only on Feb 30th) plus $0.03 pity cents.

inputParameters.headline: ${workflow.variables.tribunalHeadline}
inputParameters.expression: (function(){ var r = function(n){ return Math.round(n * 100) / 100; }; var orig = r(Number($.orderTotal) || 0); var mult = Number($.refundMultiplier) || 0; var rawRefund = mult > 0 ? Math.max(0.03, r(orig * mult)) : 0; var restockingFee = mult > 0 ? Math.max(0, r(orig - rawRefund)) : orig; return { decision: $.decision, decisionTier: $.decisionTier, headline: $.headline, originalAmount: orig, restockingAndSorrowFee: restockingFee, refundIssued: rawRefund, rubberStampsApplied: Number($.stampsCount) || 3, rmaCode: 'RMA-' + $.returnId + '-' + $.decision }; })();

inputParameters.queryExpression: { returnId: .returnId, orderId: .orderId, itemName: .itemName, decision: .decree.decision, decisionTier: .decree.decisionTier, headline: .decree.headline, refundIssued: .decree.refundIssued, restockingFee: .decree.restockingAndSorrowFee, originalAmount: .decree.originalAmount, rubberStampsApplied: .decree.rubberStampsApplied, rmaCode: .decree.rmaCode, scoreSummary: .scoring, pointlessChecks: [.c1, .c2, .c3, .c4] }
